title: Overlap can hide a drying face
hook: Which layout exposes more cloth area?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: that where two pieces of cloth overlap, that area is hidden from the air and dries last

misconception: Overlapping clothes on a rack dry as fast as separated ones, because the same cloth is out.
objective: Overlap hides the contacting regions from surrounding air. Separating the illustrated sheets restores those regions, although the total amount of cloth stays the same.

claims.text: Overlap hides the contacting regions from surrounding air. Separating the illustrated sheets restores those regions, although the total amount of cloth stays the same.
claims.source: OpenStax College Physics 2e §13.6, https://openstax.org/books/college-physics-2e/pages/13-6-humidity-evaporation-and-boiling (opened 2026-10-14). Evaporation is inhibited by humidity. The card's constant flux is an explicitly illustrative assumption, not a measured household drying rate.
